thread:
jyoti: Heads up, we're seeing a burst of VM reclaim signals in us-west1 on mixed GPU pools. Latency up ~3x for small requests.
sam: Which pools? dedicated or on-demand? :thinking_face:
jyoti: Mostly the low-cost pool (preemptible-ish) + some low-util nodes in the heterogeneous pool. It's a bit noisy, not a full-region eviction.
lee: infra-oncall, did the autoscaler kick? I see lots of scale events.
infra-oncall: autoscaler triggered scale-up + fallback routing at 1815000005. Some pods moved to gpu-burst-2.
maria: Logs show repeated Node NotReady flaps during the reclaim window. Attaching sample:
maria: ```
[kubelet] E0817 12:00:05.123 kubelet_node_status.go:90] node "gcp-usw1-gpu-pt-7" reported NotReady
[kube-proxy] W0817 12:00:06.456 conntrack: overflow
``` 
logan: conntrack overflow + eviction hints could explain connection resets. Any packet drops reported by LB?
ops-bot: deploy-bot: routed 42% of small-req traffic to fallback pool at 1815000010
sam: Can we push short-lived inference to warm dedicated instances while we drain noisy ones?
jyoti: Starting a temporary route change: re-route /v1/fast to dedicated-spotless for 60s then observe.
lee: Will that increase cost? cost-analytics, ping.
cost-analytics: Quick calc: moving 20% of small requests to dedicated adds ~$0.9/hr but reduces tail latency SLA breaches.
maria: I've started cordon+drain for 3 nodes showing repeated flaps. drainer logs: `kubectl drain gcp-usw1-gpu-pt-7 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data`
logan: Need to bump conntrack sysctl on the affected nodes? `net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max` at 131072 currently.
sam: Let's avoid sysctl changes mid-window unless necessary. First confirm reclaim signals stop.
infra-oncall: cloud provider shows reclaim spike from 1814999998-1815000030. They marked as "capacity reclaim" not full preempt.
jyoti: After route change latency dropped 40% for the affected p95. Initial telemetry: p95 down from 650ms to 380ms.
lee: Good. Keep an eye on disk pressure too; some drains hit eviction due to local cache cleanup.
maria: I've rebalanced pod anti-affinity to avoid concentrated drains. Patch applied to canary 3 replicas.
ops-bot: infra-oncall escalated to vendor-support at 1815000045
logan: If reclaim continues, recommend auto-fallback policy: route small requests to cheaper dedicated reserved pool + scaled back batching to keep tokens low.
sam: Agreed. Also add short-term retry/backoff in client to avoid thundering.
jyoti: Monitoring for 10 more mins. Will revert routing once reclaim quiets. Thanks all. :rocket:
ops-bot: incident-note: partial capacity noise in us-west1, route mitigations applied, nodes cordoned. Follow-ups: increase conntrack, refine autoscaler thresholds.
maria: Filing post-incident doc now with timestamps and graphs.
lee: small follow-up: add alert for conntrack usage hitting 75% during reclaim windows.
jyoti: End of thread for now.
